# Ebook v5 golden fixtures

These fixtures are regression assets copied from real SiftForge Gemini 3.6
Flash extraction runs. Page evidence is preserved while local filesystem paths
and unrelated source metadata are sanitized. Page images and raw provider
responses are intentionally excluded.

Prompt 5.1 fixtures: pages 18, 68, 152, 398, 402, 412.

Prompt 5 fixtures: pages 116, 378, 397.

Each `case.json` stores the model/prompt/schema provenance, page tags, and token
usage copied from the corresponding real run manifest. Token counts are kept as
stable evaluation provenance; monetary pricing is intentionally not embedded in
these fixtures.
